blocks.text: The ping command is used to test network connectivity. It checks if a device is reachable on the network. Ping sends small data packets to another device (as shown in Figure 1.16). It measures response time from the destination. This command helps detect network delays. It is commonly used to check internet connection.

Pinging google.com [142.250.190.14] with 32 bytes of data:
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=24ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=26ms TTL=118
Reply from 142.250.190.14: bytes=32 time=25ms TTL=118
